title: Logical Reasoning
description: Class 6 IMO — Logical Reasoning: number and figure patterns, analogy and classification, coding-decoding, direction sense, blood relations and logical Venn diagrams.

topics.title: Patterns, Series, Analogy & Classification
topics.concept: In a series, find the rule (add, multiply, squares) and give the next term. In an analogy, work out how the first pair is related and match it. In classification (odd one out), find the one that does not belong.

examples.solution: Each term doubles, so the next is 32.

examples.problem: Complete the analogy: cat : kitten :: dog : ___

recap: Series: find the rule, then the next term.
Analogy: match the relationship; classification: find the odd one out.

quiz.q: Which is the odd one out: 2, 4, 6, 7?
quiz.explanation: 7 is odd; the others are even.

topics.title: Coding-Decoding
topics.concept: In coding-decoding, letters or numbers are changed by a rule. One common rule shifts each letter forward by one (A→B, B→C). Another uses position values (A = 1, B = 2, …, Z = 26). Apply the rule to code or decode a word.

examples.problem: If each letter moves forward by 1, what is the code for CAT?
If A = 1, B = 2, …, what number is E?

recap: Find the coding rule (shift letters or use position values).
Apply the same rule to code or decode.

quiz.q: If each letter moves forward by 1, the code for CAT is ___ ?

topics.title: Direction Sense, Blood Relations & Venn Diagrams
topics.concept: For direction sense, picture the compass: North, East, South, West clockwise. Turning right from North faces East. For blood relations, work out the family link step by step. A Venn diagram uses overlapping circles, where the overlap shows things that belong to both groups.

examples.problem: Facing North, you turn right. Which way do you now face?

recap: Compass clockwise: North, East, South, West.
In a Venn diagram, the overlap belongs to both groups.

quiz.q: Facing East, you turn right. Which way do you now face?
quiz.explanation: Turning right from East faces South.
Your father's father is your grandfather.

questions.q: Complete the analogy: hand : glove :: foot : ___ ?
questions.explanation: A glove covers the hand; a sock covers the foot.

questions.q: Which is the odd one out: 11, 13, 15, 17?
questions.explanation: 15 = 3 × 5 is composite; the others are prime.

questions.q: If each letter moves forward by 1, the code for DOG is ___ ?
Facing North, you turn left. Which way do you now face?
questions.explanation: Turning left from North faces West.
Your father's wife is your mother.

questions.q: In a Venn diagram, students who play both cricket and football are shown by the ___ ?
questions.explanation: The overlap shows things belonging to both groups.

questions.q: Complete the series: AZ, BY, CX, ___ ?
questions.explanation: First letters go A, B, C, D and second letters go Z, Y, X, W, giving DW.

questions.q: On a clock face, which number is directly opposite 12?
Ravi walks 3 km East, then 4 km further East. How far East is he from the start?
If each letter moves forward by 1, what is the code for MONDAY?
questions.explanation: M→N, O→P, N→O, D→E, A→B, Y→Z gives NPOEBZ.
